name: sluiceway
description: One GitHub issue that shows which infrastructure stacks have changes waiting, and deploys a stack when someone ticks its box.

scripts.build: bun build src/main.ts --target=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.js && bun build src/cli.ts --target=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/cli.js
scripts.check:schema: bun run build:schema && git diff --exit-code -- schema && test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- schema)"
scripts.check:dist: bun run build && git diff --exit-code -- dist && test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- dist)"
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run check:schema && bun run check:dist
